subject: Insurance
title: Collision Coverage
description: A fast breakdown of Collision Coverage for builders.

hook.text: Collision coverage pays to repair your car after a crash.

buildup.text: The average collision claim is $4,700. For newer cars, it's essential.

discovery.text: Collision typically has a deductible: $500 or $1,000.

twist.text: If repair costs exceed the car's value, insurance 'totals' it—paying you the car's market value.

climax.text: Collision coverage decides whether a crash is a financial hiccup or a catastrophe.

punchline.text: $4,700 average claim. Collision coverage pays for your crash, not just theirs.

quiz.question: When does collision coverage apply?
options: Only when the other driver is at fault
When your car is damaged in a crash, regardless of fault
